draft.title: The changing nature of work
card: Automation
Machines or software do tasks that people once did, such as self-serve checkouts or robots in a factory. Some jobs shrink, and new jobs appear to build and run the machines.
Artificial intelligence
Artificial intelligence (AI) is software that can do tasks that seem to need thinking, such as sorting data or writing a first draft. It changes the tasks within many jobs, not only factory jobs.
Working from home
Better internet and online tools let many people do their jobs away from the workplace. This can save travel time and change how teams meet and share work.
Gig work
Gig work is short jobs paid one at a time, often arranged through an app, such as food delivery. Gig workers choose when to work, but the amount of work and pay can change from week to week.
draft.remember: New technology and new ways of working change jobs, and so the skills workers need change too.

a.q: A supermarket in Orange replaces most staffed checkouts with self-serve machines. Which change in work does this show?
a.why: Machines now do a task that cashiers once did, which is automation. It is not gig work, because the jobs are not short tasks arranged through an app.
a.clue: Who or what is now doing the task?

b.q: Tariq in Wollongong delivers meals using an app. He accepts jobs when he wants and is paid for each delivery. Which change in work does this best show?
opts: Gig work, paid one job at a time
Automation, as machines do the delivery
Working from home using online tools
b.why: Tariq is paid for each short job arranged through an app, which is gig work. Apps are technology, but they do not make this automation, because a person still does the delivery.
b.clue: Look at how Tariq is paid and how he finds his jobs.

b.best: Gig work, paid one job at a time
